onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

visited_matched_expected.Description: A boolean (or NaN) representing whether the expected and visited arm of the trial matches

visited_arm.Description: A string representing the visited arm of the trial

expected_arm.Description: A string representing the expected arm of the trial

recordings.Description: An integer value representing which recording this trial belongs to

is_familiar_maze.Description: A boolean representing whether the maze is familiar or novel

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.Ripples: The 'Ripples' table in the NWB file.
Levels.SleepStates: The 'SleepStates' table in the NWB file.
